rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for firing a gun or launching a projectile, including shooting at a target.

example.english: I shoot at targets with an air rifle.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 hei3 coeng1 se6 baa2

rows.note: Use this colloquial verb when “shoot” means leave quickly.

example.english: We need to shoot off now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 zau2 laa1

rows.note: Use this for sending an electronic message or file to someone, as in sending an email.

example.english: I’ll shoot you the file in a minute.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 cyun4 fan6 man4 gin6 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this conversational phrase in reply to “Shoot” when inviting someone to speak or ask a question.

example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 me1 man6 tai4 gong2 laa1
